title: Fix token telemetry edge case
prompt: In this repository, inspect the token telemetry parsing path. Make one small, well-tested correction for an edge case where malformed usage data could be counted incorrectly. Keep the change narrowly scoped and add or update the relevant unit test.

title: Improve task validation error
prompt: In this repository, find one task-request validation path with an unclear error. Improve the error so it states the invalid field and the correction required. Add or update a focused unit test; do not change unrelated validation behaviour.

title: Harden empty usage summary
prompt: In this repository, inspect the usage or token summary code for an empty-data edge case. Make a minimal correctness improvement, with a focused regression test. Preserve the existing public response shape.

title: Clarify runner gate diagnostic
prompt: In this repository, improve one runner gate failure diagnostic so a user can distinguish a missing gate profile from a command failure. Keep the change small, preserve existing security checks, and add or update a focused test.

title: Verify lineage gate-round accounting
prompt: In this repository, inspect task lineage gate-round accounting. Fix one concrete edge case in how failed gate rounds are counted, and add a focused regression test. Do not alter unrelated lineage semantics.

title: Harden controller JSON boundary
prompt: In this repository, find one controller JSON parsing boundary that can mishandle malformed stored data. Make a defensive, backwards-compatible improvement and add a focused unit test.
